direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, the meeting has ended. Anudi continues away as Kasun returns to his food three-wheeler.
direction.people: Anudi is in the left depth, in a cream blouse and muted teal skirt, subdued after the call. Kasun is on the right, in a faded blue shirt and dark trousers, quiet and distracted; both face away.

flow.text: Anudi walks steadily into the left depth without looking back, her phone lowered in her right hand, umbrella in her left and handbag on her left forearm.
Kasun continues toward the three-wheeler in the right depth, head slightly lowered and hands empty. He takes measured steps without reaching for anything; both figures stay apart and face away.

direction.camera: A wide 32mm shot from road-side eye level, with both full figures small on opposite depth paths, makes one slow dolly backward.
direction.sound: Continuous light rain, distant road wash and soft footsteps receding on wet ground; no music.
